newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - June 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Chittagong Port Users Forum has called off its palnned boycott programme following a government assurance of allowing the use of private equipment in cargo handling from June 30.
New Delhi has regretted the intrusion of an Indian Airforce helicopter into Bangladesh territory and assured Dhaka that steps would be taken to prevent recurrence of such incident.
Prime Minister Sheiklh Hasina, now visiting Turkey, met with Turkish President Suleyman Demirel on Saturday and asked for Turkish assistance in building a deep sea port in Bangladesh.
President of Dhaka Chamber of Comemrce and Industry, M.A. Quasem, said the 1997-98 budget would not help industry.
Federation of Bangladesh Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FBCCI) on Saturday said 2.5 percent development surcharge on import would adversely affect the manufacturing sector.
One under-trial Burmese national died on Friday in Chittagong jail of protracted illness.
The number of slum dwellers in Dhaka city rose to two million from 0.718 million in 1990.
Uruguay Round agreement will little help trade of jute and allied fibre, Jute experts said in Dhaka on Saturday. REUTER
